children: may rise toward $4,354 per ounce, as it has broken a resistance at $4,306.
The metal has stabilized around a support zone of $4,257-$4,266, formed by the 61.8% projection level of a wave C from $4,512 and the 100% projection level of a small wave c from $4,403.
Both these waves could either end around this zone or extend far below it. Regardless of the endpoints, the metal seems to be bouncing toward $4,354, as indicated by a falling channel.

A break below $4,285 would suggest the continuation of the downtrend within the channel. On the daily chart, there seems to be a false break below the support at $4,306, as the metal is trying to climb above this level, instead of falling toward $4,168.
The false break is likely to be followed by a decent bounce toward $4,417.
